summary: Velo3D filed an 8-K disclosing the September 28, 2026 separation of CFO James Suva, who also served as principal financial and accounting officer; the filing states the departure was not due to any disagreement over operations, policies or practices. The board immediately appointed Terence P. Wynn as Interim CFO and principal financial and accounting officer the same day, engaged via an Officer Services Agreement with KongBasileConsulting LLC. Terms: $32,500 monthly fee plus pre-approved expense reimbursement, prorated for partial months; Wynn remains a KBC employee, not a Company employee. Watch for a permanent CFO search, any restatement or control disclosures, and interim financial-reporting execution risk.
